prompt:

The previous strip crouches too deeply. REPLACE THE MIDDLE THREE CELLS WITH THE SAME STANDING HEIGHT AND PROPORTIONS AS THE FIRST AND LAST. Every beetle's largest ivory spike tip, entire shell, eyes, nose and pincers must be at IDENTICAL coordinates relative to its own slot. EXACT SAME RIGID UPPER BODY in all five slots. There is absolutely NO lowering, no body drop, no crouching and no vertical compression in this corrected source strip. Restoration of the same standing height is the ONLY major correction.
Keep all five cels as the same neutral standing beetle. Do not resize or squash anything. All feet are planted at identical coordinates. Maintain the original long-enough leg spacing between the shell and the feet as in image 2; do not fold the knees deeply or pull the front toes back. The same shell must sit at the same height above all six planted feet. Only tiny redrawn knee/upper-leg joint contour changes of at most 2-3 pixels may vary between the middle cels, representing mild muscle tension/release. This must look nearly still. Body breathing offset of only a few pixels will be added in final technical registration, so DO NOT draw any body-height variation into this source strip.
CEL 1: exact approved neutral. CEL 2: same neutral, tiny knee tension. CEL 3: same neutral, tiny knee relaxation. CEL 4: same neutral, return of tiny knee tension. CEL 5: exact approved neutral again. These are not steps and not different stances.
Keep image 2's exact burgundy armored beetle facing lower-left, exactly THREE ivory back spikes, two unchanged relaxed ivory inward-curving pincers, same open amber eyes, six sturdy short burgundy legs with purple-black pointed feet. Identical painted shading and clean warm ivory material in every cel, crisp dark teal outlines, smooth detailed game art. Pincer silhouettes, gap and tips absolutely identical; no mouth animation, no eye animation, no head motion, no attack, no walking, no shrinking, no rocking. Restore every cel to the same original neutral full silhouette family. One row of exactly FIVE complete full-body cels in equal-width slots, no extra rows. True transparent RGBA background, no floor, shadows, effects, labels, numbers, text, gridlines, borders, cut-off parts, gray or colored edge debris or checkerboard.
initialPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Production 2D game idle-animation artwork. Create ONE COMPLETE FIVE-CEL HORIZONTAL STRIP in one edit.
Image 1: edit target, transparent five-slot canvas containing the approved beetle in slot 1.
Image 2: APPROVED neutral beetle, exact character identity, pose, physical size, clean palette and painted style reference.

This is a QUIET STANDING IDLE loop with tiny knee flex and a very small vertical settling motion, not walking, attacking or dying. Same beetle facing lower-left in the same three-quarter front-left camera. EXACTLY THREE ivory dorsal spikes, a rigid burgundy shell, two neutral inward-curving ivory pincers, amber eyes, six short sturdy articulated burgundy legs with purple-black feet. Smooth detailed painted game sprite, crisp thin dark-teal outlines, clean warm ivory gradients. Keep lighting and colors absolutely stable across all five cels, no mottled gray, checkerboard or speckles in the ivory.

The carapace, spikes, head and pincers remain one RIGID SOLID unit of EXACTLY THE SAME WIDTH, HEIGHT AND SHAPE in every cel. No growing/shrinking, no squash/stretch, no shell inflation, no rotation, no perspective change. Keep eyes open at the exact same expression in every cel. Pincers stay in the exact same relaxed pose with the exact same gap and tips, no opening, closing or twitching. Head and pincers move only the tiny vertical amount with the rigid body, not independently. Body is supported by all six feet in a stationary stance. ALL FOOT TIPS remain planted at the SAME ground coordinates and on the SAME invisible baseline; no footsteps, no swinging limbs and no weight shift sideways. Newly draw the tiny knee/upper-joint flex connecting this slight body lowering to the stationary feet.

Five poses in a single smooth subtle idle breath:
CEL 1: EXACT original neutral from image 2, same feet, body and face. This will be restored exactly to the approved source in final assembly.
CEL 2: the rigid body/head/spikes are lowered only THREE pixels from cel 1 at a 512px slot size; leg knees bend very slightly to absorb this tiny lowering, all six feet remain planted. No body deformation.
CEL 3: lowest quiet posture, body/head/spikes lowered only SIX pixels from cel 1; same width and height as the original shell and same pincer gap. Slightly deeper knee flex, planted feet. This is a subtle resting posture, not a crouch or preparing an attack.
CEL 4: release back to the THREE-pixel-low intermediate posture, naturally drawn knee joints extending halfway to neutral, feet planted.
CEL 5: EXACT same neutral as CEL 1 and image 2, making a seamless return. No additional motion or blink.

Motion amplitude is intentionally VERY SMALL: at most six pixels vertical in the reference 512px frame, no horizontal drift or rotation. Do not exaggerate poses to make them more dramatic. Preserve original anatomical proportions and scale in every cell. Every cel contains one complete beetle in an equal-width slot with generous transparent margins. Output exactly FIVE full-body cels in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, ideally 2560x512. All art belongs inside its own slot, no overlap or cut-off spikes or feet. True transparent RGBA background. No scenery, floor, cast shadow, labels, text, numbers, gridlines, border, motion blur, duplicates, particles or checkerboard painted into transparency.
